name: Pope St John XXIII, Rochdale & Littleborough

boundary.description: From the Rochdale - Rossendale District boundary near Brownhouse Wham Reservoir, N along that boundary to Hades Hill and then along Rochdale - Calderdale District boundary, across Warland Reservoir, crossing Turvin Road (B6138) and Halifax Road (A58) to M62 Motorway near junction 22. Then W along the motorway to Lower Booth Hollins Farm and by a bee-line across Hollingworth Lake to Smithy Bridge Road and railway station. Then SW along the railway to the point it crosses Newbold railway branch. Then N by a bee-line to River Roch and W along it to South Parade. Then W to the roundabout and by a bee-line N to Spotland Road (A680) and its junction with Mount Street. Then by a bee-line S to the junction of Norman Road and Mellor Street. W and then N along Mellor Street and River Spodden to the Rochdale – Rossendale boundary and along that boundary to the point near Brownhouse Wham Reservoir

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Mary and St Patrick
internalBoundaries.description: From the Smithy Bridge Railway Station to New Road, Halifax Road, Union Road. Then W by a beeline to the junction of Thimble Close and Birch Road, N along Birch Road to its junction with Ramsden Road and W by a beeline to Rochdale – Rossendale District boundary.
